newsitem.title: USA: Columbia excecutive Jarrell goes before magistrate.
newsitem.headline: Columbia excecutive Jarrell goes before magistrate.

text.p: A Florida executive with Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp, Jay Jarrell, appeared before a federal magistrate in Fort Myers Wednesday to face conspiracy and fraud charges, a court clerk said.

Jarrell appeared before U.S. Magistrate George Swartz in hearing that began at 1400 EDT/1800 GMT. Court Clerk Al Alayon described the hearing as an "initial appearance" in which the charges were read. An arraignment and bond hearing will be scheduled later, Alayon said.
Jarrell was one of three Columbia/HCA executives charged with conspiracy and fraud in an indictment unsealed Wednesday.
